name: Kildeverket — heal the Olsen drift into markup 0.2, then the script-first editor
problemStatement: npm run case:check is green again with tiny-olsen.case.md in markup 0.2 as the single source reproducing today's tiny_olsen_slice.json, and the lab has a working script editor with live compile plus a generated Canvas view
body:
## Decisions so far

- 2026-08-05 · Heal the drift **into markup 0.2**, not into the 0.1 DSL. No throwaway 0.1 extensions. The 0.2 compiler is the healing tool.
- 2026-08-05 · Editor arrival = **script editor + Canvas view**. Pacing and Playtest views stay behind the fog as later tickets.
- 2026-08-05 · Godot runtime support for full weave semantics: **research first**, then rule. The compiler must not silently emit what the runtime cannot consume.
- 2026-08-05 · **Flow gets weave, matching gets blocks** (DD-001). calls + frank_chat are weave with card-keyed branches (`* f_x:`). recipes, proposals, pair-reject lines stay declarative. Full rulings on the ratify ticket.
- 2026-08-05 · **Emit boundary = runtime capability** (DD-002). Unplayable weave parses and warns, never emits JSON. The warning list is the engine backlog.
- 2026-08-05 · **§10 addenda ratified**: new field lines (Frank:/Card:/Reveals:/Card title:/Activity:/Max:/Opens-bracket payload), mirror rule dropped, sparse-field law, `Lead: «label» -> target` as the single leads form. Details on the ratify ticket.
- 2026-08-05 · **Proposal block = slug header** (amends 1b). `# Proposal: <handbok slug>` + `Relevant:` facts (1–3) + optional additive `Categories:` + mandatory `Line:`. order = file order, no field. Rulings A–D on the proposal-syntax ticket.
- 2026-08-05 · **The 0.2 compiler exists and is the live pipeline** (SB-023/PLAN-003). Pure ESM core in src/compiler/, gen:olsen/case:check run it, core JSON serializer writes tabs, diagnostics are the editor contract. gen:olsen:check stays red on the core JSON until the content back-port heals the drift.
- 2026-08-05 · **Proposal blocks compile** (SB-029, rulings A–D). `# Proposal: <slug>` + Relevant/Categories/Line, order and the emitted `order` field derive from file position. The compiler is now feature-complete for the SB-024 back-port.

- 2026-08-05 · **The drift is healed — first destination reached** (SB-024). tiny-olsen.case.md in 0.2 is the single source; case:check green, Godot schema/chat/lead/pack filters green. Emitted-JSON deltas vs the 35-commit HEAD are ruled on the ticket (canonical leads objects, sparse availability, answer_lines primacy). Four small compiler extensions recorded in the reference (Quote: fallback, Tanke: sting, call: lead targets, nested-bracket anchors). The legacy 0.1 generator is retired.
- 2026-08-05 · **Script-first editor passes the feel test — SB-025 closed** (Terje: "we're done with this probe. All good"). The probe (prototypes/script-editor, CodeMirror 6 over the real compiler) is the tool Terje reached for: he authored the bekymringsmelding rewrite in it across 9 iterations. Kept features: live compile + diagnostics, folding-as-outline, id autocomplete, hover docs from the reference, ⌘-click goto-definition, real bake-template previews (FUNN card + paper docs) with lightbox, localStorage draft protection. Contract wins along the way: labContent paragraphs + line breaks (slice canon untouched), bake pipeline ported to main and run (bake:docs green). The editor direction stands — Canvas (SB-026) is the open question.


Context: `tiny-olsen.case.md` last synced 2026-06-23. Since then 35 core-loop commits edited `tiny_olsen_slice.json` directly. The JSON now carries sections the 0.1 DSL cannot express: frank_chat (8), frank_proposals (24), recipes (2), calls (1), 6 day beats, pair-reject lines, vurdering_frist_day. `npm run case:check` fails. The Kildeverket handoff (Downloads/Dialog Tree Editor Mockups-handoff.zip, unpacked knowledge lives in ticket bodies) specs markup 0.2: one condition grammar, `~` effect lines, ink-style weave, stubs/TODO, compiler warnings, §10 migration from 0.1. The reference's uncovered sections are now ruled — the compiler spec is the reference plus the four ruling comments on the ratify ticket.

## Out of scope

- Pacing view and Playtest view (mockup turns exist; tickets come after Canvas lands).
- Godot runtime changes for weave features. RULED 2026-08-05: the compiler's warning list is the engine backlog (gathers, deep nesting, sequences, asked-counts, new predicate ops). Pursuing any of it is a separate core-loop map.
- Hjemmebesøk as authorable content — the visit beats are hardcoded GDScript (social_visit_director.gd), no pack representation exists for 0.2 to target.
- Retiring the JSON contract: `tiny_olsen_slice.json` stays the cross-repo artifact; only its source changes.
- Any second game implementation in the lab (pinned rule).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Charting session 2026-08-05: map created from /wayfinder. Facts: 35 core-loop commits drifted tiny_olsen_slice.json past the .case.md since 2026-06-23; case:check fails; Kildeverket handoff specs markup 0.2 + script-first studio. Rulings from Terje: heal into 0.2; editor arrival = script editor + Canvas; runtime weave support = research first. Tickets SB-020..SB-026, frontier = the two research tickets. NOTE: pm warned the data dir looks REWOUND (disk newest 2026-06-15, server previously saw 2026-07-05) — check .pm/data vs git before trusting older items.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Research session 2026-08-05 (3 parallel opus agents): SB-020, SB-021, SB-027 all resolved and closed — full findings on the tickets. Headlines: (1) Drift is wider than assumed — 7 top-level JSON sections are un-authorable today, and docs/case-content-runtime.md explicitly tells authors to hand-edit the JSON. 0.2 is the FIRST markup to claim the conversation layer, not an extension of a working emitter. (2) The runtime's choice model is card-drops, not text menus — 0.2 needs first-class card-keyed branch notation. §6 guard grammar is partly disjoint from PredicateSpec (6 terms need new engine ops; 2 shipped ops are missing from the spec). Hubs/diverts/deep nesting have no runtime slot — recommend defer, not warn. (3) Survey: make 'once' a composable modifier, effects fire on traversal, dispatch-table selection with declaration-order tiebreak (Yarn saliency/ChatMapper group+priority) fits card-keying, proposal pairs are genuinely our own construct (linter-required otherwise/soft-reject row), recipes = named condition+effect bundles. Highest-leverage tooling idea: red/green 'why hidden' trace — closed grammar makes it possible; ship before any graph view. Frontier is now the grill (SB-022) alone — next session is HITL, one ticket, hard rule.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log 2026-08-05 (wayfinder, Mode 2): grilled and closed the ratify-markup-0.2 ticket. Four rulings ratified (hybrid shape split with card-keyed branches, declarative recipe/proposal blocks, emit boundary = runtime capability, §10 addenda incl. the single Lead: form). Filed DD-001 + DD-002, minted TERM-001 card-keyed-branch. Fog graduated: engine backlog and hjemmebesøk moved to Out of scope. Frontier is now the compiler build ticket.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log (wayfinder 2026-08-05): resolved SB-028 (proposal block syntax) in a grill session. Four rulings A-D on the ticket: slug header, additive Categories:, order = file order, mandatory Line: + validation. Amends ruling 1b on SB-022 (cross-note added there). Corpus finding that forced the amendment: dagsenter and tt share the same unordered fact pair, so a pair header cannot be a unique key. Fog graduated: none — the answer feeds the existing compiler proposal-emit ticket and SB-024, no new tickets needed.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log (wayfinder, 2026-08-05): worked SB-023 — built the 0.2 compiler by executing PLAN-003's five tasks with one executor agent each, serial. Result: src/compiler/ pure ESM core (parse, §6 condition grammar, §7 effects, weave, recipes, §9 lints, typed diagnostics), spec vendored to docs/markup-0.2-reference.md with recorded extensions, equivalence oracle vs the old generator (two-entry allowlist), emit-stability golden, CLI rewired (tab core-JSON serializer). npm test 180/180, lint clean, core-loop resources untouched. Expected red: gen:olsen:check reports the core JSON stale until SB-024 heals content. Fog graduated: (1) SB-024 should also retire the old generator .mjs, now oracle-only; (2) open_conversation targets like c_frank_okonomi have no ratified weave namespace (call:/chat: exist, hub conversations do not) — flagged on SB-024; (3) uncommitted work sits in the design-lab working tree for Terje to review/commit.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log addendum (wayfinder, 2026-08-05): also worked SB-029 (independent frontier [task], fact tier). # Proposal: blocks now parse and emit per SB-028 rulings A–D; golden proves all 24 shipped proposals emit canonical-equal from a 0.2 fixture. npm test 192/192, lint clean, core-loop resources untouched. Discovery recorded: the shipped entries carry an explicit order integer field — ruling C materializes as an emitted field, not just array position. Frontier now: SB-024 (the content back-port) alone — a full session of its own.

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log 2026-08-05 (wayfinder, SB-024): back-ported the 35 commits — rewrote tiny-olsen.case.md in markup 0.2 end to end. case:check green, npm test 195/195, Godot regen + case_content_schema/frank_chat/lead/case_pack filters green. Emit diff vs HEAD reduced to the ruled set (details on SB-024). Retired the 0.1 generator + equivalence oracle. Four compiler extensions (Quote:/Tanke:/call: lead targets/nested-bracket anchor fix) tested and recorded in the reference. .case.md is now prettier-ignored (weave sigils are semantic). Frontier now: SB-025 (script-editor probe) and SB-026 (canvas probe), both unblocked. Both repos have uncommitted changes ready for review: design-lab (case file, compiler extensions, tests, docs) and core-loop (tiny_olsen_slice.json + tiny_olsen_case_pack.tres regenerated).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Session log (wayfinder mode 2, 2026-08-05): claimed SB-025 [probe] script editor. Built the probe at prototypes/script-editor/ — the mockup turn-5a studio shell over the real 0.2 compiler and the healed tiny-olsen.case.md, with live compile, outline, follows-cursor preview, problems list, status bar, and ⌘S write-back (dev-only vite middleware in vite.config.ts, @types/node added as devDep). Verified: lint green, 196 tests (new jsdom smoke test included), case:check green, save round-trip byte-identical. Ticket left OPEN and claim released — the resolution is Terje's feel verdict after playing. No other ticket touched (judgment tickets are one per session).

Nine probe iterations this session (CodeMirror swap, real bake-template previews, FUNN card, lightbox, draft protection after the lost-edit incident, paragraph + line-break contract fix in emit.ts labContent, ⌘-click goto-definition, bake pipeline ported to main and run). Cross-repo state: core-loop has uncommitted regenerated slice JSON + 9 rebaked textures + manifest (Terje's content edits flowed through) — Terje reviews and commits there. Design-lab worktree holds all probe/compiler/template changes, uncommitted. Fog graduated: SB-030 [task] STATUSRAPPORT template gap filed. Branch sb-281-humane-case-authoring is fully mined (templates, bake, port-spec doc ported; generator stack + forms-editor superseded) — safe to archive. Frontier now: SB-026 [probe] Canvas.
